ledger.com/microsoft/aad/msal4j/CustomJWTAuthen: its only constructor (protected) takes msal4j's ClientAssertion, a package-private class in 1.21.10's msal4j (javap: final class com.microsoft.aad.msal4j.ClientAssertion), so a mod subclass can pass only null; a layer class outside com.microsoft.aad.msal4j cannot declare that parameter (javac refuses it, and access wideners only tweak game classes), and msal4j 1.23 has no such class
ledger.org/apache/logging/log4j/core/async/Asyn: its last parameter, AsyncLoggerDisruptor, is package-private in 1.21.10's log4j-core 2.24.1 (javap: class org.apache.logging.log4j.core.async.AsyncLoggerDisruptor, not public), so a mod can pass only null; 2.25's constructor is package-private, and a layer factory outside org.apache.logging.log4j.core.async cannot declare that parameter type (javac refuses it; access wideners only tweak game classes)
